draft_text: Asterion outperformed RuneSpan on Meridian-QA, and Darsen and Ko found preliminary evidence that Patchwise Replay may improve exact-match accuracy on the same benchmark.
revised_text: Asterion achieved higher exact-match accuracy than RuneSpan on Meridian-QA (80.4% vs 78.0%, a 2.4-point mean gain over 8 seeds), and Darsen and Ko (2023) describe a preliminary experiment applying Patchwise Replay by revisiting high-loss training passages.
rationale: T1 shows Asterion (80.4) > RuneSpan (78.0), supporting "outperformed" as a mean difference, though no significance test was reported. P1 only describes a preliminary experiment applying Patchwise Replay; it does not state that Patchwise Replay improves exact-match accuracy on Meridian-QA. That part is unsupported.
